instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'Outfit' for all headings and 'Manrope' for body text. Install these from Google Fonts.
Follow the Electric & Neon archetype. Use deep charcoal/zinc-950 for backgrounds and bright cyan/magenta for call-to-actions, gamified XP, and AI responses.
Implement the splash screen with React Three Fiber (R3F) using the 'splash_bg' texture or dynamic particles.
Use the 'ai_tutor_mascot' image as the primary avatar for the AI Tutor in chat and on the dashboard.
Apply 'glassmorphism' (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/40 border border-white/10) to the animated sidebar, headers, and AI chat bubbles.
In dashboards, stick to the 'Control Room Grid' strategy: dense, correlated widgets. Ensure all interactive widgets have hover states (-translate-y-1, border brightening).
Integrate Shadcn components strictly for logic (forms, dialogs, dropdowns) but style them to remove the Vercel-look by applying our dark neon theme.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute for robust automated testing.
